newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine December inflation lower at 0.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine December inflation lower at 0.9 pct.

text.p: Ukraine's monthly inflation rate slowed to 0.9 percent in December from 1.2 percent in November and annual inflation in 1996 fell to a record low level at 39.7 percent, the Statistics Ministry said on Saturday.
UKRAINE CONSUMER PRICES DEC 96 NOV 96 DEC 95
Ukraine's central bank chairman Viktor Yushchenko predicted last month that the annual inflation rate would fall to 40.5 percent in 1996.
Ukraine monthly inflation slowed to a reform-era low of 0.1 percent in June and July of this year. Annual inflation reached 10,000 percent following independence in 1991.
The draft budget foresees 1997 annual inflation rate of 25 percent for the next year.
